projects.title: Elder's Veil
projects.shortSummary: A comic and manga reading platform with immersive reading, user accounts, and content management.
projects.problem: Readers need a comfortable comic-reading experience without unnecessary interface clutter.
projects.solution: Developing a responsive comic platform with comic discovery, reading features, authentication, and administration tools.

projects.title: ECE × Dev Portfolio
projects.shortSummary: A cinematic personal portfolio showcasing Electronics and Communication Engineering and web development.
projects.problem: Generic portfolio templates do not effectively communicate both engineering knowledge and software development skills.
projects.solution: A personalized portfolio combining ECE and web development sections, cinematic visuals, and JSON-driven content.
features: Dedicated ECE and web development sections

projects.title: Kabaddi Pro
projects.shortSummary: A kabaddi-focused sports platform concept for tracking matches, teams, players, and game statistics.
projects.problem: Kabaddi fans need an accessible way to follow teams, match progress, and player performance.
projects.solution: A sports application concept designed to organize kabaddi match information, team details, and player statistics.

projects.title: Music Player
projects.shortSummary: A personal music player concept for listening to tracks through a clean, modern interface.
projects.problem: Listeners want a simple interface to browse music and control playback without unnecessary distractions.
projects.solution: A music player application concept focused on track navigation, playback controls, and a responsive listening experience.

projects.title: Expense Tracker
projects.shortSummary: A personal finance application concept for recording expenses, organizing transactions, and monitoring spending.
projects.problem: Tracking daily expenses manually makes it difficult to understand spending habits and manage a budget.
projects.solution: An expense tracking application concept designed to organize transactions and provide a clear overview of personal spending.
